nom: medicube Salmon DNA PDRN Pink Vitamin Coated Sheet Mask 10EA

segments.combination: The one reviewer with combination skin reports the mask didn't cause breakouts or irritation and left her pores looking noticeably smaller.
segments.sensitive: The one reviewer with very sensitive skin reports no issues and strong hydration, but another reviewer who didn't think she had sensitive skin describes a severe reaction, with hive-like irritation and redness lasting days after leaving the mask on longer than her first use.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who specifically describes her skin as mature reports fine lines appearing softer and a noticeable boost in brightness and elasticity after just one use, with no irritation.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report softer-looking fine lines and improved brightness or elasticity with regular use, including one who saw her smile lines improve over a month of weekly use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers overwhelmingly report strong, lasting hydration and a plumper, glowier look after use, with no dissent found on this point.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no irritation, and a couple describe it actively soothing redness, including sun-related redness and irritation from tretinoin use; however, two reviewers describe more serious reactions, with burning, hives, and days of redness after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the mask is especially helpful for soothing her skin barrier when it gets irritated from tretinoin.
concerns.spots: One reviewer who used the mask for six months reports it made no visible difference in fading her old acne scars or discoloration.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with combination skin reports no breakouts or irritation from the mask.

aspects.libelle: Generous leftover serum for the body
Mask fit varies piece to piece
Plastic backing tricky to peel off

extraits.texte: Read reviews before purchasing. I didn’t think i had sensitive skin, and usually only benzoyl peroxide product make my skin dry and irritated. but after the second use of this last week my skin one morning was extremely irritated, dry, sensitive and felt like hives/rash on my skin.. i had no idea this caused it i was very confused until i came in here and read the reviews of people having the same issue. I know what the product was suppose to do. the first time i used it, i didn’t have any issues but i also took it off maybe 15-20 mins after. the second time i kept it on a lot longer at night. my skin has been really bad from this for a week now, i have to repair my skin again but now i can’t use any skin products until my face has healed. i couldn’t even be inside a room without a fan, my skin was red and irritated for days after extremely. It finally has calmed down a bit, 6 days later
Burning sensation and small hives on my face :( Within the first 5 min my face started burning :/ not using again

extraits.titre: One of the better sheets masks on the market
extraits.texte: As with all skincare products, I tried out these masks for six months before writing this review. I used the mask once a week and applied the extra serum left in the pouch 2-3 days during the week. I’ve made the mistake of keeping the mask on for too long (until it was completely dried out) thinking longer is better. NOT SO! It made creases (temporary) on my skin. Now, I take it off promptly after 15 minutes even if the mask still fits damp/sticky. I usually use the mask in the evening before going to bed and i can definitely see a difference in the morning. My skin is more glowy, more plump, and healthier looking. Dare I say I “look” a bit prettier? That, unfortunately, does not last for more than a few hours. But it does make my foundation look more flawless (I use Jung Saem Mool’s Nuder Cushion) I am not sure if PDRN is supposed to help with hyperpigmentation/discoloration, but it has not made a difference in fading my old acne scars. The few negatives: the plastic sheet the mask is wrapped in is not necessary. It merely adds to more environmental waste. Also, the fit is not consistent. The size of openings for eyes, etc are different for each mask.

Why did you pick this product vs others?: I used to dislike sheet masks since I despised the slime-y feel/texture but that has changed due to my many travels. I still preferred masks in containers but it sure does make it easier traveling with sheet masks! Anyway, since I’ve been on the hunt for the best Korean sheet masks - I’ve ordered anything and everything under the sun with suitable ingredients for my combination skin. In addition, I also know what ingredients I’d like to omit. These Medicube salmon PDRN masks made the list and during my current travel, I immediately put them to the test. Honestly, I was not expecting much but I gotta say in just this initial test - I’m kind of sold. My skin looked instantly glowy and my pores looked drastically diminished, despite a night of heavy drinking and lack of sleep. In addition, I was even more thrilled it didn’t cause breakouts and/or irritations. I dig how the sheet mask adhered to my face properly without being too small or too large and stuck to the skin well. I used the remainder of the mask on parts of my body where I’d like to combat dryness such as elbows, hands, stomach, legs and thighs. I’m trying to un-program my mind thinking a sheet mask’s essence is only suitable to be used on face/neck and not other areas. It’s wickedly good ingredients in them and why shouldn’t we? Give the best to all parts of yourself! It’s what I call proper self-care. Anyway, Medicube products can be a hit or miss for me but these sheet mas

My girls bought me the Medicube Salmon DNA PDRN masks, and I honestly didn’t know what to expect—but wow, what a difference they made on my mature skin. After just one use, my skin felt deeply hydrated, smoother, and looked much more refreshed. Fine lines appeared softer, and my face had a healthy glow that I haven’t seen in a while. Mature skin can sometimes feel dull or tired, but these masks gave me a noticeable boost in brightness and elasticity. They were also gentle, soothing, and didn’t irritate my skin at all. I highly recommended giving these a try, Medicube products are now a part of my daily skincare routine. Everyone comments on my skin now and how I don’t look my age.

extraits.titre: Worth it, helps heal skin barrier
extraits.texte: Everytime I use these mask they leave my skin feeling soft and hydrated. They're especially nice when my skin barrier gets irritated from my tretinion. My face does feel tacky after taking it off and patting the remaining essence in but after it bit, when it fully dries, it feels soft and plump. They're easy to use. Just wash your face, dry it and put the mask on.

extraits.titre: The best facemask I ever used!
extraits.texte: I have used countless facemasks and this one is my favorite! I might be biased because I have a slight obsession with PDRN products because they make such a big difference in my skin, besides retinol, this is my all-time favorite ingredient! These masks are packaged really well and are very saturated with serum, once I apply the mask to my skin, I use the leftover product and rub it over my neck, chest and shoulders. The mask stays in place and is very hydrating, I leave it on longer than suggested and wait until it starts drying up to get its full effect, my skin is left soft, healthy looking and very moisturized. I also love the salmon color of the mask! Medicube never disappoints, I have so many of their products and they all work really well with my very sensitive skin, I’m more than happy to pay a bit extra for these high-quality products.
